Simulation with 18-Outcome POVM

\[\Pi_{A} = \int_S d\hat{\lambda} \prod_{a \in A}\Theta(\hat{x}_a\cdot\hat{\lambda})\prod_{a \notin A}(1 - \Theta(\hat{x}_a\cdot\hat{\lambda})) \Pi_{\hat{\lambda}}\]

where \(A = A_+ \cap A_-\) is one of 18 regions

Let's simulate \(M_1^{r=\frac{1}{2}}\)!

\(M_1^{r=\frac{1}{2}}\) was in \(\operatorname{POVM}_+\), so we can simulate it using \(\Pi^+\): \[\begin{multline}M_1^{r=\frac{1}{2}} = k_+ \sum_{A_+ \subset \{5^+, 1, 2\} } p_+(1|A_+) \Pi^+_{A_+} = \\ = k_+ (\frac{2}{k_+}\mu_1 - X_+) \Pi^+_{\{1,2\}} + (1 - \frac{2}{k_+}\mu_5)) \Pi^+_{\{1,5^+\}} + \\ + \Pi^+_{\{1\}} + Y_+ \Pi^+_{\{5^+\}})\end{multline}\]

And then express \(\Pi^+\) using \(\Pi_{A}\): \[\begin{aligned} \Pi^+_{\{1,2\}} &= \Pi_{\{1,2,5−\}} + \Pi_{\{1,2,3,5−\}} + \Pi_{\{1,2,4,5−\}} \\ \Pi^+_{\{1,5^+\}} &= \Pi_{\{1,3,5+\}} + \Pi_{\{1,4,5+\}} + \Pi_{\{1,3,4,5+\}}\\ \Pi^+_{\{1\}} &= \Pi_{\{1,5−\}} + \Pi_{\{1,4,5−\}} + \Pi_{\{1,3,5−\}}\\ \Pi^+_{\{5^+\}} &= \Pi_{\{4,5+\}} + \Pi_{\{3,5+\}} + \Pi_{\{3,4,5+\}} \end{aligned}\]

\[\begin{aligned}M_1^{r=\frac{1}{2}} &= \sum_{A} p(1|A) \Pi_{A}\\p(1|A) &= k_+ p_+(1|A_+)\text{,}A = A_+ \cap A_-\end{aligned}\]

Response function for \(A = A_+ \cap A_-\): \[\begin{aligned}p(1|A) &= k_+ p_+(1|A_+) & p(2|A) &= k_+ p_+(2|A_+)\\p(3|A) &= k_- p_-(3|A_-) & p(4|A) &= k_- p_-(4|A_-)\end{aligned}\]

Let's check normalization: \[\begin{multline}\sum_{a=1}^4 p(a|A) = k_+ p_+(1|A_+) + k_+ p_+(2|A_+) + \\ + k_- p_-(3|A_-) + k_- p_-(4|A_-)\end{multline}\]

Let's check normalization: \[\begin{multline}\sum_{a=1}^4 p(a|A) = k_+ p_+(1|A_+) + k_+ p_+(2|A_+) + \\ + k_- p_-(3|A_-) + k_- p_-(4|A_-) = \\ = k_+(1 - p_+(5^+|A_+)) + k_-(1 - p_-(5^-|A_-))\end{multline}\]

Let's check normalization: \[\begin{multline}\sum_{a=1}^4 p(a|A) = k_+ p_+(1|A_+) + k_+ p_+(2|A_+) + \\ + k_- p_-(3|A_-) + k_- p_-(4|A_-) = \\ = k_+(1 - p_+(5^+|A_+)) + k_-(1 - p_-(5^-|A_-)) = \\ = k_+ + k_- - 2\mu_5 = \mu_1 + \mu_2 + \mu_5 + \\ + \mu_3 + \mu_4 + \mu_5 - 2\mu_5 = 1\end{multline}\]
